row: We are a non-profit animal rescue. Most of the animals that come here, stay here to live a peaceful carefree life and are treated with love and kindness. These animals all come from different situations and different abusive or desperate living conditions. We strive to let the animals know they can trust humans again and they are in a safe place. These animals basic care, medicine if needed, maintenance needs like regular trimming, vaccinations, and supplements. We moved to this 23 acres to retire and enjoy the simple life. Instead we are busier than ever. The rescue just happened by accident but has truly become a labor of love for us. We hope you enjoy our journey.
